# Radoslav Radev Believes Normal Progress From Straddle Planche To The First Straddle Planche Push-Up Takes Three Months

Radoslav Radev says he believes normal progress from straddle planche to the first straddle planche push-up takes three months. [src: vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 13:01]

## Details

- He says it is only four steps, only four weeks, or two or three weeks on one step, which is almost like three months of focused work. [src: vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 12:40]
- He says some students learn the first straddle planche push-up after the second or third week, or the first month, after they have the straddle. [src: vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 12:52]
- He believes normal progress from straddle planche to the first, second or third straddle planche push-up is three months. [src: vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 13:01]

## Evidence

- vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 12:40 (Radoslav Radev): "so guys this is how for only four steps only for four weeks or if you spend on one step like two or three weeks is almost like three months or something like this focused work"
- vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 12:52 (Radoslav Radev): "yes you have students that they're learning the first straddle planche push-up after the second or third week or the first month after they have the straddle"
- vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 13:01 (Radoslav Radev): "but normal progress i believe is from straddle plunge [planche] to first straddle plunge [planche] push-up or second one or third one for three months"
